title: Learned optimizer restricted to Mirror coordinates
hypothesis: On related few-shot linear tasks represented by one shared physical basis plus a 3-value Mirror code, a shared learned recurrent optimizer updating only m reaches lower held-out query error after four support updates than tuned SGD, Adam, and Meta-SGD on that same m, while staying within 5% of a full-weight learned optimizer and using at least 30% fewer actual serialized restartable library bytes for eight tasks.

mirror_insertion.native: Shared linear function map W0 with task-specific adaptation of its full 12 weights.
mirror_insertion.exact: W(x;theta,m)=x@(W0+sum_j m_j B_j), where theta={W0,B_1..B_3}; all task adaptation updates m only.
mirror_insertion.physical_object: One shared W0 and three shared orthonormal matrix basis tensors.
mirror_insertion.coordinate: Three float32 coefficients m plus optimizer recurrent state.
mirror_insertion.logical_multiplicity: Eight related task-specific linear predictors from the same physical W0 and B bank.
mirror_insertion.persistent: m and optimizer state retained per task; learned optimizer weights shared across tasks.

task_family.basis: Seeded orthonormal basis in R^(3x4), fixed per meta-training world and serialized/charged.
task_family.teacher: W_t=W0+sum_j z_tj B_j; z_j independently distributed N(0,sigma_j^2), sigma=(0.2,0.5,1.0).
task_family.meta_optimizer: Adam lr=1e-3 over recurrent learned-optimizer weights
task_family.outer_training: Each meta-update samples a fresh batch of task identities and support/query examples from the development task family; held-out development task identities are separate.

learned_optimizer.architecture: Coordinate-shared LSTMCell with input [sign(g)*log1p(abs(g)), log1p(abs(g))], hidden width 8, scalar delta head initialized to zero; one recurrent state per optimized scalar.
learned_optimizer.mirror_variant: Same optimizer architecture updates only three m coordinates; W0/B are frozen.
learned_optimizer.full_variant: Same-size optimizer architecture updates all 12 W coordinates from W0; this is the independent full-weight upper control.
learned_optimizer.optimizer_state: Persist LSTM h,c per task and charge their bytes.

controls: Mirror code + SGD; tune lr in {0.03,0.1,0.3,1.0} on development only
Mirror code + Adam; tune lr in {0.03,0.1,0.3,1.0} on development only
Mirror code + Meta-SGD (meta-learned initialization and per-coordinate step sizes; 256 outer updates at lr=1e-3)
Full 12-weight Adam; tune same lr grid on development only
Full 12-weight learned recurrent optimizer (same learned optimizer architecture, separately meta-trained)

development.tuning: Only the Adam/SGD learning-rate grid may select settings on development tasks; learned optimizer architecture and outer-loop update count are frozen.
development.report: Per-task query MSE by update 0..4; four-update quality, actual bytes for eight-task resumable libraries, optimizer forward/backward compute proxy, wall-clock and per-task adaptation state.

fresh.worlds_or_seeds: Generate new task-family seeds only if every predeclared gate passes on both development worlds.

paid_objects: per-task LSTM h/c or SGD/Adam moments
storage.library_size: Eight task states plus one shared model/basis/optimizer payload; serialize and reload exact bytes.

pass: Across both development worlds, learned Mirror optimizer mean four-update query MSE is at least 15% lower than the best of Mirror SGD, Adam, and Meta-SGD.
Across both development worlds, learned Mirror optimizer mean query MSE is no more than 1.05x full-weight learned optimizer.
Eight-task restartable Mirror learned-optimizer payload is at least 30% smaller than full-weight learned-optimizer payload by actual serialized bytes.
All gates hold in each development world; no fresh tasks opened before this decision.
gates.fail: Any PASS clause fails on either development world, the learned optimizer is unstable/nonfinite, or serialization roundtrip changes results.
gates.not_established: Implementation/hardware/dependency blocker; incomplete or corrupted controls; or inability to run the frozen development protocol.

boundaries: Fixed four-update learning-efficiency screen; no capacity claim.
No natural-language task, production learned optimizer, GPU or hardware claim.
Full learned optimizer is an upper control, not a Mirror-specific win by itself.

meta_sgd.method: Meta-learn initial m and one per-coordinate update scale using the same 256 outer meta-updates and training task batches; apply the learned update rule for four support steps.
meta_sgd.purpose: Simpler learned update control: isolates whether recurrent gradient/history learning adds value over static learned update geometry.
